end.summary:
Practised physical, mental and social parts of health and linked them with daily habits.
Practised planning changes such as eating breakfast, sleeping earlier, reducing phone games and playing outside; effects were identified partly, with consistency to check next time.
The idea that health only means not being sick appeared again in turn 11 and was corrected in turns 12–13 by linking health with body, mind and relationships.
Discussed how sleep, food, activity, screen use and talking to others can affect health; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Siya practised describing health through physical, mental and social aspects, and connected habits such as sleep, breakfast, activity, screen use and talking with others to their effects. A mix-up that health only means not being sick came up again, then was corrected later by including the mind and relationships. At home, ask Siya to choose one small routine change and say which part of health it may support; the links still need more practice for consistency.

Aapne Arjun aur Neha ko compare kiya: fit dikhna poori health ka proof nahi, aur udaasi aur akelapan bhi matter karte hain. Aapka kisi bharosemand insaan se baat karne ka sujhaav achha hai. Ab Rohan bimaar nahi hai, phir bhi poori tarah healthy kyon nahi ho sakta?

kyunki health sirf bimaar nahi hona matlab nahi... usme mental aur social bhi aata hai na. jaise agar rohan bahut kam sota hai, hamesha tension leta hai aur doston se baat nahi karta, toh bimaar nahi hai phir bhi poori tarah healthy nahi hai. body, mind aur friends sab important hai

Aapne Rohan ke liye sahi wajah di: bimaar na hone par bhi kam neend, tension aur doston se doori health par asar daal sakti hai. Ab aadaton ko teen hisson se jodte hain: doston ke saath football, nau ghante ki neend, maa se pareshaani ki baat aur ek phal khaana, inmein se har ek physical, mental ya social health ke kis hisse mein aayega?

umm... football toh body ke liye physical hai, aur doston ke saath hai toh social bhi... neend se body ko aaram, aur mood bhi fresh hota hai toh mental... maa se baat karna mental bhi hai aur social bhi... aur phal khaana sirf physical, body ke liye...

Aapne football ko physical aur social, neend ko physical aur mental, aur maa se baat ko mental aur social se joda. Phal khaana physical health ko support karta hai. Ab ek aur aadat dekhein: exam se pehle roz sirf paanch ghante sone par padha hua zyada yaad rahega ya kam, aur kyon?
kam yaad rahega... kyuki jab neend poori nahi hoti toh dimaag thak jaata hai, padha hua bhi bhool jaate hain... jaise exam ke din aankh lagti hai, yaad nahi aata

Haan, kam neend se exam mein dhyaan aur yaad rakhne mein dikkat ho sakti hai; aapne uski wajah bhi batayi. Ab roz ki neend aur movement ke liye kya sujhaav hai: aapki umar mein raat ko lagbhag kitne ghante sona aur din mein kitni physical activity karna chahiye?
itne ghante neend... umm, 8 se 10 ghante chahiye na, aur physical activity roz ek ghanta, jaise khelna ya daudna? kyunki humari body abhi grow kar rahi hai, aur neend se dimaag fresh rehta hai

Haan, aapne dono sujhaav bataye: aath se das ghante neend aur roz lagbhag ek ghanta activity. Ab ek roz ke routine par lagate hain: naashta chhodna, school ke baad teen ghante mobile games aur raat ek baje sona. Aap kaunse do chhote badlaav karenge, aur har badlaav health ke kis hisse ki madad karega?

umm... main toh subah ka naashta kabhi nahi chhodti, warna school mein pet mein ajeeb lagta hai aur dhyaan bhi nahi lagta... toh pehla badlaav naashta karna, aur raat ko 1 baje nahi, 10 baje so jaana chahiye, kam se kam 8-9 ghante neend ho...

Haan, aapne do badlaav diye: naashta karna aur raat ko jaldi sona. Aapka school wala example dikhata hai ki naashta chhodne se pet aur dhyaan dono par asar pad sakta hai. In dono badlaavon se health ke kaunse hisse ko madad milegi, aur kaise?

achcha, maine pehle hi bola na, naashta karna chahiye aur jaldi sona chahiye... naashta se body ko energy milti hai aur class mein dhyaan lagta hai, toh physical aur mental dono. aur agar 1 baje nahi, 10-11 baje so jayein toh 8-9 ghante neend hogi, body aaram karegi aur dimaag fresh rahega, toh physical aur mental again. aur woh 3 ghante mobile games ki jagah thoda khelne jaayein doston ke saath,

Haan, aapne pehle hi dono badlaav bataye the; maine phir pooch liya, sorry. Ab aapne unka physical aur mental asar bhi samjhaya, aur doston ke saath khelna social health se bhi judta hai. Ek nayi situation mein teenon hisson ko saath dekhte hain: exam ke dauraan jo cousin bahut padhte hain, khelte nahi aur kisi se baat nahi karte, unhe aap kya chhoti salaah denge aur kyon?

umm... dekh, agar woh bimaar nahi hai, koi bukhaar nahi, toh bas padhna theek hai na? doctor ke paas jaane ki zaroorat nahi hai... health ka matlab hai beemari nahi hona. tension toh hogi thodi exam ki, lekin sabko hoti hai, doesn't matter.

Aap keh rahe hain bukhaar nahi hai, toh health theek hai. Lekin is cousin ko bukhaar na hote hue bhi khelne ka waqt nahi mil raha aur woh kisi se baat nahi kar raha; health mein body ke saath mann aur rishton ka haal bhi aata hai. Agar woh roz 30 minute dost ke saath walk kare, toh kaunse hisse badal sakte hain, aur kyon?
teeno... matlab body, mann aur rishte. walk karegi toh body active rahegi, phone nahi dekhegi toh dimaag ko aaram, aur dost ke saath time spend karegi toh social health better hogi.

Bilkul, aapne walk ka body par, phone se break ka mann par, aur dost ke saath waqt ka rishton par asar sahi samjhaya. Ab ek aur wajah sochiye: pareshaani ho toh kisi bharosemand insaan se baat karna health ki aadat kyon hai?

kyunki agar mann mein kuch chal raha hai, akela rakha toh aur zyada bhaari lagta hai... kisi ko bata do toh thoda halka ho jaata hai, stress kam hota hai. aur baat karne se connection banta hai na, koi sunne wala hai yeh feel hota hai, toh mann aur rishte dono aache rehte hain
Bilkul, aapne bataya ki baat karne se stress halka hota hai aur rishton mein sahara milta hai. Ab health ke teen hisse ek baar yaad kijiye: kaunse hain?
